About Indigo

More Than Dinner.

Good food brings people together. At Indigo, every detail is designed around the moments worth remembering — from the first drink at the bar to the last course shared at the table. Set in the heart of Wolverhampton, Indigo brings together authentic Indian cooking, a considered cocktail list, and a room built for long evenings.
